title: Backpack Feature Explorer
prompt:
Create a single HTML file with an interactive 3D backpack feature explorer using Three.js. The scene uses a horse.glb model as a decorative pack-horse mascot displayed alongside the product features.

SCENE SETUP:
- Use Three.js with GLTFLoader from CDN (unpkg or jsdelivr)
- Load 'horse.glb' using GLTFLoader. Scale the model to fit nicely (scale ~0.01) and position it at (2, 0, 0). The horse serves as the brand mascot for the 'Trail Horse' backpack line.
- Create a stylized backpack using Three.js geometry: a main body (BoxGeometry 1.2 x 1.6 x 0.6, rounded feel with MeshStandardMaterial color #2E5090), two shoulder straps (thin curved boxes, color #1A1A1A), a front pocket (slightly protruding box on the front face, color #3A6AAA), a side water bottle pocket (CylinderGeometry on the right side, color #3A6AAA), and a top handle (small torus segment on top, color #1A1A1A). Group all backpack parts under a single Group called backpackGroup, centered at (-1.5, 0.8, 0).
- Set background color to #F5F0EB (warm off-white).
- Add ambient light (intensity 0.5) and a directional light from (3, 5, 4) with intensity 1.0 and castShadow enabled.
- Camera at position (0, 1.5, 5) looking at (0, 0.8, 0). Use OrbitControls but limit polar angle to [0.2, 1.5] and distance to [3, 10].

FEATURE HOTSPOTS:
- Create 5 clickable hotspot markers (small SphereGeometry radius 0.08, emissive MeshStandardMaterial, color #FF6B35) placed on the backpack at these locations relative to the backpack group:
  1. 'main_compartment' - center of main body (0, 0, 0.35)
  2. 'front_pocket' - center of front pocket (0, -0.3, 0.5)
  3. 'straps' - on left shoulder strap (-0.45, 0.4, 0.1)
  4. 'water_bottle' - on side pocket (0.7, -0.2, 0)
  5. 'top_handle' - on the top handle (0, 0.85, 0)
- Each hotspot pulses (scale oscillates between 0.8 and 1.3 using sine wave).

UI OVERLAY:
- Create a DOM panel (div#feature-panel) positioned at top-right (right: 20px, top: 20px), width 280px, with rounded corners, white background, subtle shadow, padding 20px. Initially shows: title 'Trail Horse Backpack' and subtitle 'Click a hotspot to explore features'.
- When a hotspot is clicked (use raycaster on click), the panel updates with feature name and description text. Also highlight the clicked hotspot by changing its color to #FFD700 (gold) and reset previously selected hotspot to #FF6B35.
- Feature descriptions:
  1. main_compartment: 'Main Compartment' / '30L capacity with laptop sleeve fits up to 15.6 inch devices. Waterproof YKK zippers.'
  2. front_pocket: 'Quick Access Pocket' / 'Organized front pocket with key clip, pen holders, and phone sleeve.'
  3. straps: 'Ergonomic Straps' / 'Padded shoulder straps with adjustable sternum strap. Breathable mesh backing.'
  4. water_bottle: 'Bottle Holder' / 'Expandable side pocket fits bottles up to 32oz. Elastic drawstring closure.'
  5. top_handle: 'Grab Handle' / 'Reinforced nylon top handle rated for 50kg. Padded grip.'

INTERACTION - ROTATION MODE:
- Add a button#auto-rotate-btn at bottom-center that toggles auto-rotation of the backpackGroup (rotate Y axis at 0.01 rad/frame). Button text toggles between 'Auto Rotate: OFF' and 'Auto Rotate: ON'. Default is OFF.

INTERACTION - COLOR THEMES:
- Add 3 small circular buttons (div.color-btn) at bottom-left for color themes: 'Navy' (#2E5090), 'Forest' (#2E7D32), 'Burgundy' (#7B1F3A). Clicking changes the main body and pocket materials. The currently active theme button gets a 2px gold border.

INTERACTION - EXPLODE VIEW:
- Add a button#explode-btn at bottom-right. Clicking toggles 'explode view' which animates backpack parts apart: straps move back by Z-0.5, front pocket moves forward by Z+0.5, water bottle moves right by X+0.5, top handle moves up by Y+0.5. Use smooth lerp animation over ~30 frames. Button text: 'Explode View' / 'Assemble'.

HORSE MASCOT:
- The horse model should slowly bob up and down (Y oscillation amplitude 0.1, period ~3 seconds).
- Add a small label div#mascot-label positioned via CSS2DRenderer or absolutely positioned, near the horse, saying 'Trail Horse Mascot'.

STATE MANAGEMENT:
- Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with these fields, updated every frame:
  - horseLoaded: boolean, true once horse.glb loads successfully
  - selectedFeature: string|null, name of currently selected hotspot (e.g., 'main_compartment') or null
  - featureCount: number, total hotspots (always 5)
  - autoRotate: boolean, current auto-rotate state
  - currentTheme: string, 'navy'|'forest'|'burgundy' (default 'navy')
  - exploded: boolean, whether explode view is active
  - horsePosition: {x, y, z} current horse model position
  - backpackRotationY: number, current Y rotation of backpackGroup
  - hotspotColors: array of 5 hex color strings for each hotspot
  - panelVisible: boolean, true if feature panel is in the DOM
  - cameraDistance: number, distance from camera to origin
physics_constraints: Horse bobbing follows sinusoidal motion: y = baseY + 0.1 * sin(time * 2.094). Auto-rotation increments Y rotation by 0.01 rad/frame. Explode animation uses lerp factor ~0.1 per frame. Orbit controls constrained: polar [0.2, 1.5], distance [3, 10].
